name: get_postgres_slow_query_pattern_details
description: Returns up to the 10 most recent individual executions for a single Postgres slow query pattern from the last 24 hours, plus aggregate metrics for the pattern when available. For exact drill-down from list_postgres_slow_query_patterns, pass queryId, dbName, dbUser, dbOperation, and app exactly as returned; pass app as an empty string when the selected pattern has no application_name. Omit app only when intentionally querying across all applications. Each execution includes duration, rows, buffer/temp/WAL/JIT/CPU counters, and the error message and SQLSTATE if it failed. Durations are in microseconds. The execution sample is capped at 10 rows, so when aggregate is present rely on its fields for totals.

app.description: Postgres application_name of the pattern, exactly as returned by list_postgres_slow_query_patterns. Pass an empty string for a pattern with no application_name; omit only to match all applications.

dbName.description: Database the pattern ran in. Copy the dbName of the selected pattern from list_postgres_slow_query_patterns; together with queryId, dbUser, dbOperation, and app it identifies one pattern.

dbOperation.description: Top-level SQL operation type of the pattern, such as SELECT or UPDATE. Copy the dbOperation of the selected pattern from list_postgres_slow_query_patterns.

dbUser.description: Database user that executed the pattern. Copy the dbUser of the selected pattern from list_postgres_slow_query_patterns.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns the Postgres service. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.

queryId.description: Stable identifier for the query pattern, as returned by list_postgres_slow_query_patterns

serviceId.description: Managed Postgres service the pattern was observed on. Use the id of a postgres-type service returned by get_services_list.
